generation.seed_adjustment: ProjectManager.AskForMigrate was changed from true to false only in each disposable audit seed so CubeMX 6.17 RC5 could run headlessly; the tracked USB production IOC was not migrated or saved by CubeMX.

requirements.evidence: Production IOC CPN/package and F407 startup/linker/CMSIS selection.
Production IOC 12 MHz HSE, HSE PLL source, M6/N168/P2/Q7 and 168/42/84 MHz clocks; Gen1/Gen2 output agrees.
Production IOC assigns PA13 SWDIO and PA14 SWCLK with Serial Wire debug.
Production IOC selects TIM14 HAL timebase and 1 kHz ThreadX tick; generated source and low-level port agree.
Production IOC and gpio.c set PH12 red, PH11 green, PH10 blue to RESET/off before output initialization.
Only evidenced PA4/PB0 chip selects and PG6 reset are driven safe; removed peripheral pins remain unassigned/reset and full JTAG is disabled.
Production IOC and generated can.c select CAN1 PD0/PD1 at 1 Mbps with BS1=10, BS2=3, prescaler=3.
Production IOC and generated can.c select CAN2 PB5/PB6 at 1 Mbps with BS1=10, BS2=3, prescaler=3.
No EN/STB GPIO or transceiver part/revision is present in RM26 or current production evidence; schematic or hardware measurement is required.
Production IOC and generated usart.c select USART1 PA9/PB7 at 921600 with RX/TX DMA.
Production IOC and generated usart.c reserve PC10/PC11 and configure USART3 RX-only DBUS at 100000 9E1 with circular RX DMA.
Production IOC and generated usart.c select USART6 PG14/PG9 at 115200 with RX/TX DMA.
Production IOC and Gen2 agree on exactly five UART DMA streams; OTG FS uses interrupt-driven PCD with DMA disabled.
Generated IRQ tree contains CAN1/2 TX/RX0/SCE, USART1/3/6, five DMA streams, OTG FS at priority 5, TIM14 and ThreadX core handlers.
F4 target uses matching ThreadX 6.1.10 common and Cortex-M4 GNU port with 11 KiB pool and stack checking.
pnx_bsp/dwt enables CoreDebug TRCENA and DWT CYCCNT; DWT is deliberately absent from IOC metadata.
Hash-locked Phase-1-patched reference IOC remains outside the graph; production removes CRC/I2C/SPI/extra TIM closure while retaining the reviewed OTG FS USBX CDC closure and safe GPIO.
Production IOC and Gen1/Gen2 select PA11 DM, PA12 DP, device-only OTG FS, internal full-speed PHY, no VBUS sensing and IRQ priority 5.
Accepted USBX 6.1.10 source graph contains core, STM32 DCD and CDC ACM only; the handwritten lifecycle registers one CDC class and the board backend adds exactly one worker.
Generated ST identity is rejected by a reviewed descriptor overlay. VID/PID default to zero and the DCD remains stopped until an authorized non-ST identity and stable serial are explicitly confirmed.
